scope: Sustained production raster parallel swap, managed pressure, cancellation/retry and actual Metal SDR/HDR readback

fixture.kind: original authored finite linear-sRGB RGBA32F collection

command: RRRAH_GPU_BACKEND=metal RRRAH_METAL_COLLECTION_SECONDS=180 cargo test -p rrrah --test ttl_swap_metal long_lived_large_collection_cache_preserves_swap_and_metal_frames --target-dir /tmp/rrrah-required-corpus-target -- --ignored --exact --nocapture
limitations: Managed pressure is reservation-based, not physical OS-wide RAM exhaustion
Warm local disk/OS cache, not physical slow-disk qualification
Cancellation occurs after scratch admission, before first read of the parallel hash batch; partial-batch physical reads are covered separately by swap integration regression
SDR full-frame and HDR 63x65 pre/post-spill GPU references establish identity, not independent color accuracy or physical display output
Reference CPU vectors, expected frame readbacks, GPU allocations and thread stacks outside the CPU root budget
Eight original synthetic frames, not a camera/100-format corpus
No universal latency or throughput claim from this integrity stress run; NVIDIA deferred
